title: Identify the full name and hometown (city, county, state) of the Secretary
question: Identify the full name and hometown (city, county, state) of the Secretary who attended a social event held at '900 E. Washington St.' and also generated the highest total income for the club.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_035", T1."XCL_036", T5."XCL_045", T5."XCL_046", T5."XCL_047"
FROM member AS T1
INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1."XCL_034" = T2."XCL_002"
INNER JOIN event AS T3 ON T2."XCL_001" = T3."XCL_010"
INNER JOIN zip_code AS T5 ON T1."XCL_041" = T5."XCL_043"
WHERE T3."XCL_015" = '900 E. Washington St.'
  AND T3."XCL_013" = 'Social'
  AND T1."XCL_038" = 'Secretary'
  AND T1."XCL_034" = (
    SELECT T4."XCL_029"
    FROM income AS T4
    GROUP BY T4."XCL_029"
    ORDER BY SUM(T4."XCL_026") DESC
    LIMIT 1
  )
